Actor Randeep Hooda aids Assam flood victims; Kerala rains cause deaths

Actor Randeep Hooda visited Sivasagar district in Assam to distribute flood relief and participate in aid efforts, including serving food at a langar. Meanwhile, in Kerala, rain-related incidents have resulted in 15 deaths and seven people missing, with rescue operations ongoing. In Assam, the flood situation showed improvement, with the number of affected people decreasing to 1.78 lakh, and the Chief Minister planned to visit the worst-hit districts. Assam also launched Orunodoi 3.0 payments for 37 lakh women, which included flood relief.
